facts.fact: Neela opened her shuttered lamp once, a thumb's width, when Asha came down the west stair; Neela does not remember doing it. Vellan watched from the landing in bear shape.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires a glimmer of lamp at the stair foot that Asha mistook for Devan.

facts.fact: Devan is carried up the cut on a guard-shed door with its strap hinge still on; Thankam binds his dead right arm to his chest with a green sash.
facts.why: needed because the beat has him carried on a door.

facts.fact: Vellan is opened by a hook from hip to ribs and dies unbound, so no wound-share. His dead hand holds Kamalakshi's bad bird.
facts.why: needed because the beat has him opened at the belly and dying with the bird.

facts.fact: The queen has burned twenty-six of the thirty crown-leaf pages at the namings; four remain, matching the four unready guards.
facts.why: needed because the beat has the leaf mostly ash; the figure follows the four unready guards (F940).

facts.fact: The Company is down to about thirty-odd of forty-two odiyans at dawn, with no individual deaths named other than Vellan.
facts.why: needed because the beat implies losses on the line after ch 25-26; no names added.
